units.source_text: 终于挨到了秋天，气候渐渐凉爽，

en.t: At last autumn arrived, and the weather gradually grew cooler,

units.source_text: 紫夫人的精神也略略好转，然而还不可靠，稍不经心，病就复发。

en.t: Lady Murasaki's spirits also improved a little, but her condition was still uncertain, and the slightest carelessness would bring the illness back.

units.source_text: 秋风虽然还不曾“染上人身”，但紫夫人总是垂泪度日。

en.t: Although the autumn wind had not yet begun to pierce the body, Lady Murasaki still spent her days in tears.

units.source_text: 明石皇后即将回宫，紫夫人想请她暂留数日，希望多得见面，但觉不便启口。

en.t: The Akashi Empress was about to return to the palace, and Lady Murasaki wished to ask her to stay a few more days so they could meet more often, but she felt it was hard to say so.

units.source_text: 况且皇上不断遣使来催皇后回宫，亦不便强留，因此并不提出请求。

en.t: Moreover, the Emperor kept sending messengers to urge the Empress back to the palace, so it would not do to detain her by force, and Lady Murasaki made no request.

units.source_text: 但紫夫人不能到她那边去相送，只得让皇后到这里来告辞。

en.t: But Lady Murasaki could not go to see her off, so she had no choice but to have the Empress come to her room to say farewell.

units.source_text: 要她劳驾，实不敢当。

en.t: To trouble her to come in person seemed truly more than she deserved.

units.source_text: 但倘不再见面，就此相别，则又觉遗憾。

en.t: Yet if they parted like this without seeing each other again, she would feel deep regret.

units.source_text: 于是在房中为皇后另设一席，请她进来。

en.t: So she had a separate seat prepared for the Empress in her room and invited her in.

units.source_text: 紫夫人已非常消瘦。

en.t: Lady Murasaki had grown terribly thin.

units.source_text: 但正因为如此，增添了无限高尚优雅之相，容姿实甚可爱。

en.t: Yet for that very reason, an immeasurable nobility and grace had been added to her appearance, and her figure was truly lovely.

units.source_text: 以前青春时代，相貌过分娇艳，光彩四溢，有似春花之浓香，反而浅显。

en.t: In her younger days, her beauty had been almost too dazzling and radiant, like the heavy fragrance of spring flowers, and had seemed somewhat obvious by comparison.

units.source_text: 今则但见无限清丽之相，幽艳动人。

en.t: Now, however, only an endlessly pure and delicate beauty could be seen, a quiet loveliness that moved the heart.

units.source_text: 似此美质，而不能久留于世，教人想起了伤心之极，悲痛无已。

en.t: That someone of such beauty and refinement could not remain long in this world was enough to bring one to the height of sorrow, with grief that would not end.

units.source_text: 是日傍晚，秋风凄楚，紫夫人想看看庭前花木，坐起身来靠在矮几上。

en.t: That evening, as the autumn wind blew mournfully, Lady Murasaki wanted to look at the flowers and trees before the garden, so she sat up and leaned against a low armrest.

units.source_text: 此时源氏主君进来了，他一看见，就说道：“今天你能起坐，真难得了！

en.t: Just then Lord Genji came in, and as soon as he saw her, he said, "How wonderful that you can sit up today!

units.source_text: 皇后在这里，你的心情自然爽快起来。”

en.t: With the Empress here, your spirits must naturally have brightened."

units.source_text: 紫夫人看见自己略微好些，源氏主君便如此欢喜，不胜伤心。

en.t: Seeing Lord Genji so delighted merely because she was a little better, Lady Murasaki was overcome with sorrow.

units.source_text: 因念自己死了，不知源氏主君将何等悲恸。

en.t: She thought that if she died, there was no telling how bitterly Lord Genji would grieve.

units.source_text: 悲从中来，感极赋诗：

en.t: Grief rose from within her, and in the extremity of feeling she composed a poem:
